summary:
**AstroAdventure** is an interactive 3D and Augmented Reality (AR) educational platform designed to make space exploration exciting and accessible for children aged 7–12.

We developed a mobile application that transforms complex astronomy and space science concepts into interactive games, simulations, and hands-on experiences. The platform features 29 interactive 3D models, 11 astronomy laboratories, an Astronaut Academy, and a 10-day Lunar Base Survival Simulator where children learn to manage oxygen, energy, water, and radiation protection. It also introduces a unique multiplayer mode that allows two players to explore the Solar System and build a lunar base together using a local Wi-Fi connection, without requiring internet access.

AstroAdventure addresses the challenge of making space education more engaging and understandable by replacing passive learning with exploration, experimentation, and teamwork. Our goal is to inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers, and space explorers.
details:
Project Details — AstroAdventure

AstroAdventure is a mobile educational platform that combines 3D visualization, Augmented Reality (AR), interactive simulations, and multiplayer experiences to make space science accessible and engaging for children aged 7–12.

The application offers several learning environments. Astronaut Academy introduces children to astronaut training, space missions, and scientific experiments. The 3D & AR Laboratory allows users to explore 29 interactive 3D models of planets, spacecraft, and other astronomical objects and visualize them in their real-world surroundings. The platform also features 11 interactive astronomy laboratories and a 10-day Lunar Base Survival Simulator, where players manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, energy, and radiation protection.

One of our most distinctive features is Multiplayer Co-op. Two players can connect through a local Wi-Fi hotspot and explore space or build a lunar base together without requiring an internet connection.

Technologies Used:

  • Flutter and Dart for cross-platform mobile development.
  • Google Model Viewer and model_viewer_plus for 3D visualization.
  • ARCore, Scene Viewer, and Quick Look for augmented reality experiences.
  • GLB/glTF for 3D assets.
  • Node.js for procedural 3D model generation.
  • TCP Sockets for local multiplayer communication.
  • SQLite for local data storage.

Innovation and Impact:

Our creative approach combines education, gaming, augmented reality, and collaboration in one platform. Instead of passively reading about space, children actively explore, experiment, solve problems, and make decisions. We considered the target age group's learning abilities, intuitive interaction, scientific relevance, mobile device compatibility, and offline accessibility.

Our intended impact is to improve children's interest in STEM education, develop scientific curiosity and critical thinking, and inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers, and space explorers.
